'''Vorgan''', also known as '''Vorgan the Volcano''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] warrior who served the [[Advozse Hegemony]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, Vorgan was considered a champion of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]] and was stationed along with two of the planet's other champions, [[Gjonfs]] and [[2R-CH]], on [[Hammer Station]], a salvaged Republic [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. The trio served under [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Kreshan]] on the station as he used it to conquer several worlds of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], eventually entering the orbit of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] to demand its surrender. While the station was in the planet's orbit, an enemy strike team made their way on board and fought their way through the Hegemony's forces there. The team eventually encountered Vorgan and the other champions in the station's security control section where they battled and killed them.<ref name="TOR:HS" />

==Equipment==
Vorgan wore [[Color/Legends|yellow-and-red]] combat armor and a dark blue helmet. While defending Hammer Station, Vorgan fought with an [[M-40 Fusion Vibrosword]].<ref name="TOR:HS" />
